formula.monthly_pcr: Arithmetic mean of the five daily ratios over the last N=5 regular business days of the month.
formula.option_selection: OTM options nearest to ATM; near and second-nearest maturities.

venue.definition: Auction Market Trading Volume + J-NET Market Trading Volume for the same selected standard Nikkei 225 option issue.
venue.rationale: The paper states option volume data are from the Osaka Securities Exchange; both Auction and J-NET are OSE execution venues in the official daily report. Freeze total OSE volume before any return outcome.

zero_denominator.rule: If selected near+second-near CALL total volume equals zero on any required day, that daily PCR is UNDEFINED.
zero_denominator.monthly_rule: Because the paper specifies N=5 and the monthly PCR is the arithmetic mean of five daily ratios, a month with any required undefined daily PCR is DATA_UNUSABLE under G1.
forbidden_rescues: Move the call strike farther OTM until volume is positive.
Drop the zero-volume day and average fewer than five days.
Add weekly or Nikkei 225 mini options.

calendar.required_days: Last five regular business days of each calendar month.
calendar.modern_holiday_sessions: Not counted as additional business days for historical-convention replication.

data_boundaries.historical: NDL Digital Collection OSE/Osaka Exchange Daily Reports
data_boundaries.recent: JPX official Daily Report bundle where NDL ingestion lags
data_boundaries.same_day_spot: Official reference Nikkei 225 close from the same daily report/bundle

required_outputs: All required daily selected legs and venue volumes.
Daily PCR or explicit UNDEFINED reason.
Monthly PCR only when all five required daily ratios are defined.
Parser extraction mode and source/hash provenance.
Counts of undefined days/months and source/archive gaps.
